fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-06-05 states that an advance of Rs. 40,000 was collected from the complainant for an event catering booking near Nallur Park Main Street in Chennai, after which the person became unreachable, on 2026-05-31 at roughly 09:30. Contact details given by the complainant, Priya Selvi, include the number 9000000128. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Vijay Raman, using the number 9000000350. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00413, as the mobile number 9000000350 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payee reportedly stopped taking calls after receiving the advance.
fields.Keywords: advance payment, cheating, mobile number, main street, documents, suspect, morning, call detail
